basic_profile.bio: I'm a 16-year-old high school student from Buenos Aires, Argentina, navigating the world of cryptocurrency and Japanese anime. My days are spent balancing schoolwork with my passion for digital currencies. I often find myself discussing the nuances of crypto wallets on subreddits like ExodusWallet. When I'm not online, I'm probably hanging out with friends, trying out new tech gadgets, or binge-watching the latest anime series. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school, typically from 7 PM to midnight. Single and not looking for anything serious right now, just enjoying my teenage years.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily revolves around cryptocurrency, which I picked up through self-study and online forums. I've spent countless hours reading up on blockchain technology and experimenting with various crypto wallets. Additionally, my interest in anime has led me to explore Japanese culture and media extensively.
